extracted.intended_audience: Researchers in mathematical logic; prospective authors submitting to The Journal of Symbolic Logic
extracted.subtask_short: submitting to Journal of Symbolic Logic
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and expectations for authors preparing and submitting research manuscripts to The Journal of Symbolic Logic. Emphasizes high quality, innovation, broad interest, and compliance with the journal's author-instructions and submission-system requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research quality / highest quality
rubrics_metrics.description: The Journal of Symbolic Logic publishes research in mathematical logic and its applications of the highest quality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Papers submitted should meet the journal's top-tier standards; the journal's prestige derives from the standard of submissions and of reviewing. Implicitly, submissions should be rigorous, correct, and of substantial intellectual merit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Papers are expected to exhibit innovation and not merely be minor variations on established work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions must contribute novel ideas, results, methods, or perspectives rather than incremental or trivial modifications of existing literature; avoid submitting work that is only a minor variation on established work (explicit anti-pattern).

rubrics_metrics.name: Broad interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Papers should be of interest to a broad audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitted work should appeal beyond a very narrow subcommunity of specialists within logic — aim for results or exposition that engage a wider readership in mathematical logic and its applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow the journal's author instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Please review this journal's author instructions, particularly the preparing your materials page, before submitting your manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must consult and adhere to the detailed author instructions and the 'preparing your materials' page for formatting, required files, cover letters, ethical statements, and other preparation steps prior to submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the journal's secure submission system / account requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: We partner with a secure submission system to handle manuscript submissions. You will need an account for the submission system, which is separate to your Cambridge Core account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create and use the partner submission-system account (separate from Cambridge Core) to submit manuscripts; follow the 'Proceed to submission system' flow linked on the journal page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect editorial and reviewing standards
rubrics_metrics.description: The journal's prestige derives from the standard of submissions -- which, combined with the standards of reviewing, contribute to its high citation record.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should anticipate rigorous peer review and ensure submissions meet strong standards of novelty, correctness, clarity, and significance to succeed through the editorial and review process.
